plain_claim: In any raw resource algebra R : RawRA α satisfying all three discrete core-free RA laws (OpAssoc R, OpComm R, and ValidOpL R), discarding part of a composite resource is always right-frame-preserving: a · b ⤳ a for all a b : α (with ValidOpL R globally necessary for universal dropping via Toy.RA.validOpL_of_fpUpdate_drop_right_all).

hypotheses.name: hAssoc
hypotheses.purpose: Regroups (a · b) · f into (a · f) · b before projecting validity with ValidOpL.

hypotheses.name: hComm
hypotheses.purpose: Moves the discarded piece b past the frame f so b sits on the outside of (a · f) · b; without commutativity, b can act as a compatibility bridge between a and f.

hypotheses.name: hValidOpL
hypotheses.purpose: Projects validity of a · b to validity of a (empty frame) and validity of (a · f) · b to validity of a · f (non-empty frame); globally necessary for universal dropping (Toy.RA.validOpL_of_fpUpdate_drop_right_all).

ValidOpL is the only globally necessary law: (∀ a b, a · b ⤳ a) → ValidOpL R (Toy.RA.validOpL_of_fpUpdate_drop_right_all).

plain_claim: In any raw resource algebra R : RawRA α possessing a global right identity e (IsRightUnit R e) — with none of OpAssoc, OpComm, ValidOpL, or R.valid e required — optional right-frame fpUpdate R a b is equivalent to bare non-empty right-frame fpUpdateBare R a b.

hypotheses.purpose: Supplies a single carrier element e with a · e = a and b · e = b so the empty-frame check reduces to instantiating fpUpdateBare at f = e.

non_claims: The equivalence with the bare form is for right-composed frames only; without OpComm, neither fpUpdate nor fpUpdateBare need protect left-composed frames (and even with OpComm, simultaneous two-sided contexts l · (a · r) additionally require OpAssoc; Toy.RA.opComm_alone_not_two_sided).

IsRightUnit is sufficient, not necessary, for fpUpdate ↔ fpUpdateBare: non-unital algebras with right identities on valid elements and ValidOpL (such as agreeRA Bool) also satisfy the equivalence via Toy.RA.fpUpdate_iff_bare_of_rightIdOnValid_validOpL.

Does not permit dropping the optional empty frame in non-unital algebras without right identities on valid elements, such as exclRA or fracValRA, where fpUpdateBare erroneously permits updating valid elements to invalid ones.

plain_claim: In any raw resource algebra R : RawRA α where every valid element admits a right identity (HasRightIdOnValid R) and validity is downward closed on the left (ValidOpL R) — without requiring a global unit, right identities on invalid elements, core laws, OpAssoc, or OpComm — optional right-frame fpUpdate R a b is equivalent to bare non-empty right-frame fpUpdateBare R a b.

hypotheses.name: hRightId
hypotheses.purpose: Supplies a right identity c for a valid source a (a · c = a) so R.valid a triggers fpUpdateBare at f = c to yield R.valid (b · c); weakens HasLocalRightUnits to valid elements only.

hypotheses.name: hValidOpL
hypotheses.purpose: Projects R.valid (b · c) to R.valid b when a's right identity c is not a right identity for b; tight at size 2 under HasRightIdOnValid, OpAssoc, and OpComm (Toy.RA.two_element_comm_validOpL_witness), and tight at size 5 even when HasLocalRightUnits, OpAssoc, and OpComm all hold (witnessed by fiveLocalUnitsNoValidOpLRA; nothing is claimed about smaller witnesses).

nonvacuity_witness: agreeRA Bool has no global right unit (Toy.RA.agreeRA_bool_no_rightUnit), satisfies HasRightIdOnValid and ValidOpL, and rejects ag false ⤳ ag true.
non_claims: The equivalence with the bare form is for right-composed frames only; without OpComm, neither fpUpdate nor fpUpdateBare need protect left-composed frames (and even with OpComm, simultaneous two-sided contexts l · (a · r) additionally require OpAssoc; Toy.RA.opComm_alone_not_two_sided). HasRightIdOnValid (and HasLocalRightUnits) is not Iris's CmraTotal: it asks only for some right identity per valid (resp. arbitrary) element, which need not be idempotent, canonical, or monotone. HasLocalRightUnits corresponds to the multi-unit axiom of Dockins-Hobor-Appel (APLAS 2009, axiom (15)), without cancellativity.
Does not apply to non-total, non-unital algebras without right identities on valid elements (such as exclRA or fracRA), where fpUpdateBare is strictly weaker than fpUpdate.

When every element is idempotent (x · x = x) and OpComm holds, fpUpdate coincides with fpUpdateBare without ValidOpL (Toy.RA.fpUpdate_iff_bare_of_idemp_opComm). So no commutative algebra in which every element is idempotent is a tightness witness for ValidOpL; a commutative witness may still contain idempotent elements (in zeroBoolRA, false · false = false, and false is the source of the separating pair (false, true) of Toy.RA.two_element_comm_validOpL_witness). Without OpComm, an idempotent, associative 2-element tightness witness with HasLocalRightUnits exists (Toy.RA.idempotent_noncomm_validOpL_witness).

Does not show that HasLocalRightUnits is required on invalid elements (Toy.RA.rightIdOnValidOnlyRA_props constructs a 3-element commutative, associative, ValidOpL algebra meeting HasRightIdOnValid where HasLocalRightUnits fails).
Discrete algebras: does not cover step-indexed CMRAs (✓{n}) or OFE cameras; it neither establishes nor refutes the corresponding claims about them.
